headline: Muted Q2, watchful of margin recovery in H2FY27

highlights: Triveni Turbine (TRIV) reported another weak quarter, with revenue declining 3% YoY to INR4.9bn and EBITDA margin contracting sharply to 13.0%, impacted by an adverse order mix, execution of the strategic NTPC order and higher raw material costs.

The company reported its highest- ever quarterly order inflow, up 17.2% YoY to INR7.6bn, driven by exports (+49.8%) and product (+32.5%), while domestic and aftermarket inflows declined 2.5% and 17.8%, respectively.
Order book stood at INR24.5bn, up 10.5% YoY, with a higher aftermarket contribution led by refurbishment, utility, geothermal and performance-optimisation opportunities.
Domestic and product order books remain subdued, although upcoming thermal capacity additions could drive large turbine order finalisations in Q4.
